==Summary==

{{pov|[[Faile Bashere]]}}

[[Faile]] and the others are forced to march naked through the snow by the group of roughly 150 [[Shaido]]. A tall [[Aiel]] named [[Rolan]] leads Faile. To stay focused and alert, she tries noting anything that could aid in their escape. After hours of marching, feet bloodied, Rolan hauls her on his shoulders and carries her onwards. Faile, even colder without the constant running, worries about frostbite.

[[Bain]] and [[Chiad]] accept their fate - a year and a day as ''[[gai'shain]]'' and are able to keep up with the Shaido. [[Lacile Aldorwin]] and [[Arrela Shiego]] of Cha Faile, try to emulate the Aiel Maidens with some success. [[Maighdin]] and [[Alliandre]] struggle frequently, leading to their beatings.  Eventually, they are also carried by Shaido. 

The cold and running motion gradually lulls Faile to sleep. She dreams of [[Perrin]], running across an icy landscape, and then a bonfire. She wakes and a ''gai'shain'' gives her almost scalding, honeyed tea to drink. She and the other women are camped out being warmed by a fire with blankets, coats, and tea. Faile realizes the ''gai'shain'' were not with them on the march, so they must have joined an even larger Shaido camp. She sees thousands of Shaido around and begins despairing of escape.
